summary: Iteration 4 (Alert Threshold, Farmer Statement Sharing, Season Comparison, Entry Validation) fully verified. Backend: 12/12 new tests in test_iteration4.py PASS -- (a) /company-profile returns rate_alert_threshold (default 20), admin PUT persists to 50 and back, operator gets 403 on PUT; (b) farmers master accepts+persists email; (c) /dashboard/seasons returns current/previous/growth with 1 Nov–31 Oct window (current label 2025-26, previous 2024-25); operator can GET; (d) sale within stock (20 bags purchased -> sell 10) succeeds; sale of 50 bags with only 5 in stock -> 400 with detail 'Only 5 bags of this product are in stock…'; potato lot over-sell -> 400 mentioning bags; editing an existing sale to same qty succeeds (exclude_sale_id works); (e) POST /api/ledger/{farmer_id}/email-statement returns 200 with sent_to=delivered@resend.dev; 400 for farmer with no email; 403 for operator. Frontend: admin login OK. Dashboard Season Comparison table renders with current & previous labels, rows Purchases / Sales / Margin / Bags purchased, 'no prior data' for empty previous, footer notes 'Season runs 1 November – 31 October'. Settings page shows Rate Alert Threshold (%) input (data-testid settings-field-rate_alert_threshold); saving 50 persists after reload; restored to 20. Farmers table has Email column; add-form has farmers-field-email. Ledger page: WhatsApp & Email buttons both disabled until a farmer is chosen; after selecting Ramesh Patel WA button opens https://wa.me/... URL (browser follows redirect to api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=91…&text=Shree+Potato+Traders — text/phone preserved). Sale-over-stock UI: attempting to sell 9999 bags of GST Test Seed shows toast 'Only 0 bags of this product are in stock. Reduce the quantity or record a purchase first.' and dialog stays open (no save). Regression: existing test_iteration3.py has 4 failures caused by pre-iteration-4 tests creating sales without matching purchases — the new stock validation now (correctly) blocks them; these are old-test artefacts, not app bugs (see rca).
action_items: (optional) update legacy test_iteration2.py TestOutstanding and test_iteration3.py TestGST/TestRateStats to seed a purchase before creating sales, so they no longer trip the new stock-validation rule. Not an app bug — new feature works exactly as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: available_stock() opening_qty is intentionally only applied when lot_no is empty (product-level check). Correct, but worth a code comment.

assert_sale_stock() runs after clean_txn(), so bags/amount are already coerced; good. However when payload has rate_basis='weight', the check still uses doc['bags'] for the availability comparison — if a user creates a weight-basis sale with 0 bags but big weight, no stock check happens. Consider extending to weight-based inventory when needed.

email_statement passes user (the required-admin dep) both as dependency and as the get_ledger user arg — the recipient still comes from the farmer record, so the admin-only guarantee holds; well designed.
SeasonComparison hides itself entirely when /dashboard/seasons request fails (silent catch). Consider showing a small error banner so admins know the widget failed to load.
Ledger.jsx shareWhatsapp() falls back to +91 for 10-digit numbers but uses raw digits otherwise — good; the wa.me handoff worked and included the closing balance text.

CrudPage.jsx rate threshold is now read from /company-profile — good. Threshold is fetched once when the dialog is mounted with rateAlert, so changing threshold in Settings requires a page refresh on the entry screen (acceptable but a minor UX note).

rca of the issue: Regression failure RCA: test_iteration2/3 created sales directly against products with 0 (or negative) computed inventory. Iteration 4's new assert_sale_stock() at server.py:364-381 blocks these with HTTP 400. Reproduction: POST /api/sales for a product with no prior purchase -> {'detail': 'Only 0.0 bags of this product are in stock. Reduce the quantity or record a purchase first.'}. Mitigation: in each legacy sale-creating test, first POST /api/purchases with matching category+product_id+bags before POST /api/sales. This is a legacy-test update, not an application bug — the feature works exactly per spec.
